imf.label: Inflation rate, average consumer prices (annual % change)
imf.note: IMF WEO projects about six years ahead; values from forecastFrom onward are IMF projections. Headline inflation covers all items - it is not food inflation.

source.name: World Bank Commodity Markets "pink sheet", monthly, nominal USD
WFP food prices for Yemen (via HDX, public dataset)

yemen.note: National monthly median of market retail prices. Yemen has two currency zones, so rial prices are converted to USD per market with the unofficial exchange rate reported in the same dataset for that market and month (WFP's published USD column uses an outdated official rate and is not used). Months with fewer than 5 convertible markets are suppressed. Market-level observations, not a consumer price index.
